dialogue.speaker: Maria
dialogue.text: Bună ziua, bine ați venit la hotel. Aveți o rezervare?
dialogue.en: Hello, welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Da, o cameră pentru două nopți, pe numele meu.
dialogue.en: Yes, a room for two nights, under my name.

dialogue.speaker: Maria
dialogue.text: Da, iat-o. O cameră single cu vedere spre grădină.
dialogue.en: Yes, here it is. A single room with a view of the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Maria
dialogue.text: Da, micul dejun este inclus, de la șapte la zece. Iată cheia dumneavoastră.
dialogue.en: Yes, breakfast is included, from seven to ten. Here is your key.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thank you. What is the room number?
